entries.title: The System, Documented
entries.dek: The living style guide for this site — every token, module and rule it is built from. The panels on the right render from the live components, so when the system changes, this page changes with it.

entries.title: How this journal works
entries.dek: Technical documents shouldn't scroll their diagrams away. This journal pins each chunk's media beside the text it belongs to — the pattern DDS builds into product documentation.
